profile_text: Specializing in IT consulting and system integration services, this German firm has experienced a 36.4% growth since its baseline, driven by its expertise in helping businesses navigate complex technology landscapes. With a focus on tailored solutions, the company's services are in high demand, leading to an expansion of its workforce to 150 employees in 2024. As a result, it has earned a categorization as a Scaler, reflecting its rapid expansion and increasing market presence.
